title: gendn immutable conformance suite
description: Per reference-page conformance contract. Once committed the assertions array is immutable: assertions are never deleted, weakened, or regenerated to go green — you FIX THE PAGE instead. Adding assertions (growing coverage) is allowed. `suiteHash` is the sha256 of the normalized assertions array and lets the validator detect weakening. These are DOC-QUALITY assertions for a reference site; platform-BEHAVIOR belongs to the chrome-platform-showcase conformance contract this page may reference via `cpsFeature`, never forked here.

id.description: Stable page id `v<N>/<slug>` — must equal a published route in the manifest.

identity.description: The chromestatus.com feature id this page documents (invariant #3). Never repoint.

demo.description: The chrome-platform-showcase route this page embeds/links for its OWN feature, or null.

cpsFeature.description: When this page wraps/links a chrome-platform-showcase feature, the canonical CPS identity and its explicitly listed conformance assertions. CPS conformance does not prove native, hardware, permission, backend, or other behavior its suite does not assert; gendn references the listed contract without forking it.

suiteHash.description: sha256 (hex) of the normalized assertions array. Recomputed by the validator; a mismatch means the file was hand-edited without regenerating the hash, and a git-baseline diff catches assertion removal/weakening.

evidence.description: Retained REAL evidence for manual-evidenced assertions: screenshot path, console excerpt, note.
